mapper.select: with recursive CODE_LIST(SYS_CD, P_SYS_CD, SYS_TP, SYS_NM, SYS_DS_LST, SYS_DESC, DEPTH, PATH, CYCLE, CRET_DT, CRET_USER_ID, UPDT_DT, UPDT_USER_ID) as ( select A.SYS_CD, A.P_SYS_CD, A.SYS_TP, A.SYS_NM, A.SYS_DS_LST, A.SYS_DESC, 1, array[A.SYS_NM::text], false, A.CRET_DT, A.CRET_USER_ID, A.UPDT_DT, A.UPDT_USER_ID from TB_SYS_INFO A where A.P_SYS_CD is null union all select A.SYS_CD, A.P_SYS_CD, A.SYS_TP, A.SYS_NM, A.SYS_DS_LST, A.SYS_DESC, B.DEPTH + 1, array_append(B.PATH,A.SYS_NM::text), A.SYS_CD = any(B.PATH), A.CRET_DT, A.CRET_USER_ID, A.UPDT_DT, A.UPDT_USER_ID from TB_SYS_INFO A, CODE_LIST B where A.P_SYS_CD = B.SYS_CD and not CYCLE ) select SYS_CD, P_SYS_CD, SYS_NM, SYS_TP, SYS_DS_LST, SYS_DESC, DEPTH, PATH, to_char(to_timestamp(CRET_DT,'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'),'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') as CRET_DT, CRET_USER_ID, to_char(to_timestamp(UPDT_DT,'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'),'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') as UPDT_DT, UPDT_USER_ID, (select S.DICT_ID from TB_SYS_INFO S where S.SYS_CD = CODE_LIST.SYS_CD) as DICT_ID, (select D.DICT_NM from TB_SYS_INFO S join TB_STD_DICT D on D.DICT_ID = S.DICT_ID where S.SYS_CD = CODE_LIST.SYS_CD) as DICT_NM from CODE_LIST order by PATH
select SYS_CD from TB_SYS_INFO where SYS_NM = #{sysNm} order by SYS_CD limit 1

SELECT M.DM_ID as "dataModelId" ,M.DM_NM as "dataModelNm" ,M.MODEL_TYPE as "modelType" ,M.DICT_ID as "dictId" ,(SELECT D.DICT_NM FROM TB_STD_DICT D WHERE D.DICT_ID = M.DICT_ID) as "dictNm" FROM TB_DATA_MODEL M WHERE M.DM_SYS_CD = #{sysCd} AND (M.USE_YN = 'Y' OR M.USE_YN IS NULL) ORDER BY M.DM_NM

SELECT DS_ID as id ,DSN as dsn ,DS_TP as dsTp ,DBMS_TP as dbmsTp ,DRIVER_NM as driverName ,SVR_ADDR as svrAddr ,PORT as port ,USER_ID as userId ,CHARSET as charSet ,PRIVATE_KEY as privateKey ,DB_NAME as dbName ,RM_DIR as rmDir ,CONN_PROPS as connProps ,CONN_TEST_YN as connTestYn ,CONN_TEST_DT as connTestDt FROM ndata.tb_data_source

with recursive CODE_LIST(SYS_CD, P_SYS_CD, SYS_DS_LST, DEPTH, PATH, CYCLE) as ( select A.SYS_CD, A.P_SYS_CD, A.SYS_DS_LST, 1, array[A.SYS_NM::text], false from TB_SYS_INFO A where A.SYS_CD = #{sysCd} union all select A.SYS_CD, A.P_SYS_CD, A.SYS_DS_LST, B.DEPTH + 1, array_append(B.PATH,A.SYS_NM::text), A.SYS_CD = any(B.PATH) from TB_SYS_INFO A, CODE_LIST B where A.P_SYS_CD = B.SYS_CD and not CYCLE ) SELECT distinct DS_ID as id ,DSN as dsn ,DS_TP as dsTp ,DBMS_TP as dbmsTp ,CONN_TEST_YN as connTestYn FROM ndata.tb_data_source WHERE DS_ID IN (SELECT UNNEST(CASE WHEN array_length(SYS_DS_LST, 1) >= 1 THEN SYS_DS_LST ELSE '{null}'::text[] END ) FROM CODE_LIST)

SELECT DS_ID as id ,DSN as dsn ,DS_TP as dsTp ,DBMS_TP as dbmsTp ,DRIVER_NM as driverName ,SVR_ADDR as svrAddr ,PORT as port ,USER_ID as userId ,PWD as pwd ,CHARSET as charSet ,PRIVATE_KEY as privateKey ,DB_NAME as dbName ,RM_DIR as rmDir ,CONN_PROPS as connProps ,SECURE_YN as useSecure FROM ndata.tb_data_source WHERE DS_ID = #{id}
SELECT ADM_YN FROM tb_user WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND (DEL_YN = false OR DEL_YN IS NULL)
